name: 3D Skew-Normal Splatting
definition: A scene representation method that replaces the standard symmetric 3D Gaussian kernel with the Azzalini Skew-Normal distribution to model asymmetric structures like sharp boundaries and one-sided surfaces, while preserving analytical tractability under affine transformations.
summary: 3D Skew-Normal Splatting is a volume rendering method using a learnable skewness parameter to model asymmetric structures, distinguishing itself from symmetric Gaussian splatting.
